flora: Individual moss plants (extreme close-up showing tiny, pointed green leaves, almost translucent)
Sporophytes (thin, reddish-brown stalks rising from the green moss cushion)
Capsules (the 'heads' of the stalks, distinct in shape, where spores are stored)
A dense, cushion-like moss clump, highlighting its velvety texture
ground_palette: Burnt orange (for sporophyte stalks and capsules)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; extreme focus on 'softness' and velvet-like texture; clean, high-contrast details of the tiny capsules; sense of micro-world complexity.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition. Top-left: Extreme macro of individual moss leaves, showing their translucence. Top-right: A 'forest' of thin reddish sporophytes rising from the green moss. Bottom-left: A detailed close-up of a single spore capsule. Bottom-right: A hero shot of a soft, round moss cushion, emphasizing its dense, plush texture.
visual_logic.ground: A dark, wet rock surface with fine mineral textures peeking through the green, providing a stark contrast.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft, even, diffused daylight to highlight the delicate, almost glowing nature of the moss leaves and the distinct forms of the sporophytes.
